technical.summary: Severe oversold conditions with long-term trend support are offset by pervasive short-term bearish structure, negative momentum, and three-black-crows pattern; high risk of continued downside before any reversal.

fundamental.summary: AOS shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 34 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for conviction.

sentiment.summary: No current congressional signal; Fear index (36) presents mild contrarian opportunity, but stale trades (585+ days old) and absent news data limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (91.5) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinationals; FOMC event just passed adds volatility; earnings in 34 days presents moderate binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: EMA 50/200 bullish crossover and ADX trending signal provide long-term structural support, with price near support level (61.90) offering defined risk entry for mean-reversion traders betting on oversold bounce.
debate.key_bear_argument: Pervasive short-term bearish structure (RSI 21/27 with no recovery, three-black-crows pattern, negative CMF, stoch_k 2.61, price below all EMAs/SMAs, MACD negative) combined with severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis 91.5, strong dollar, zero fundamental support, earnings binary in 34 days) creates unacceptable risk-reward for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Already holding AOS with existing position; sector concentration at 7/33 positions limits conviction. Oversold technicals (RSI 21/27, stoch_k 2.61) offer mean-reversion appeal, but severe macro headwinds (VIX 91.5, inverted yield curve, strong dollar) and zero fundamental support make entry unjustified.
